svg.text: THIS module: case, its own drawers / wheels, and scheduled doors.
Images show actual saved model geometry; exploded views are identification aids.
1. Build this top box separately on a flat surface: Back, Sides, Bottom and Top.
2. Fit its scheduled divider / shelf before trial-fitting the doors.
3. Check selected hinges and prepare LED-driver / cable access where shown.
4. Lift with help, temporarily support, then secure to suitable wall structure.
5. Finish its door adjustment only after the fixed case is level and anchored.
